subject: Next steps: brief product walkthrough & stakeholder alignment
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodai.com>
To: Kate Jensen <kate.jensen@averycorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + 3 short windows for a 30-min walkthrough

Hi Kate —

Thanks again for a great discovery session earlier today. Quick recap of what stood out on our side:
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency on critical customer-facing flows and get predictable per-token costs for batch scoring.
- Key constraints: must run inside our VPC, require audit logs for model requests, and have an SLO on 95th pct latency.
- Success metric for pilot: <20% cost reduction vs current infra w/ equivalent latency.

Next step: 30-minute product walkthrough + brief infra/ops touchpoint to confirm integration surface for your engineers. Below are three compact windows that work for our team (all PT):
1) Tue Jun 1 — 09:30–10:00 PT
2) Wed Jun 2 — 11:00–11:30 PT
3) Thu Jun 3 — 14:00–14:30 PT

If none of those work we can offer a late-afternoon PT slot on Thu as backup. Please let me know which one fits and who on your side should join (we recommend a technical owner + an infra/security contact).

I've attached a short post-discovery notes PDF and a draft mutual action plan (spreadsheet) so you can see how we usually structure pilots.

Attachments: post-discovery-notes.pdf (PDF, 240 KB); mutual-action-plan.xlsx (Excel, 18 KB)

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

Dylan Brooks
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0187 | dylan.brooks@redwoodai.com
Redwood Inference — inference, made predictable

From: Kate Jensen <kate.jensen@averycorp.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 15:47:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + 3 short windows for a 30-min walkthrough

Dylan —

Thanks for the recap and the materials. The notes look useful; I shared the spreadsheet internally. We can do option #2 (Wed Jun 2, 11:00–11:30 PT). I'll invite our technical owner Tom Alvarez (cc'd below) and our security lead if his schedule allows.

Proposed attendee list from Avery:
- Kate Jensen — Product lead (myself)
- Tom Alvarez — Principal Infra Engineer (tom.alvarez@averycorp.com)
- Possibly: Manuel Ortiz — Head of Security (if he can join)

Two quick asks for the agenda:
1) 10 minutes — high-level architecture fit and deployment options (VPC/on-prem/dedicated)
2) 15 minutes — demo of low-latency serving + caching examples tied to our use case
3) 5 minutes — next steps and pilot checklist

If you need any more prep from our side (logs, sample token sizes), tell me and we'll surface them ahead of the call.

Appreciate it — locked in for Wed at 11:00 PT.

Best,
Kate
Kate Jensen
Product Lead, Avery Corp
kate.jensen@averycorp.com

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=avery-demo-4921 (invite sent)

- 11:05–11:15 — architecture & deployment fit (Marcus)
- 11:15–11:25 — live demo: low-latency serving, caching, and routing examples (Marcus)
- 11:25–11:30 — next steps & pilot checklist (Naomi)

If Manuel can join, happy to surface the audit/logging material early in the call. Otherwise we'll send the audit checklist in advance.

See you Wed. I'll follow up tomorrow with the calendar invite (ICS) and a one-pager for Tom.
